MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE) AS b
WHERE (p.draft_pick IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <= 62)
   OR p.birth_date = '1997/8/7'
   OR (p.college IS NOT NULL AND p.college <> 'Oregon State University')
   OR (p.nba_championships IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 2)
WITH p, b,
     date_diff('year', b, DATE('2026-10-14')) -
     CASE WHEN date_part('month', b) > 10
                OR (date_part('month', b) = 10 AND date_part('day', b) > 14)
          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN p.draft_pick AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  COALESCE(TRY_CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64), TRY_CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ',', 2) AS INT64)) AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN TRY_CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'January' THEN 1
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'February' THEN 2
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'March' THEN 3
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'April' THEN 4
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'May' THEN 5
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'June' THEN 6
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'July' THEN 7
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'August' THEN 8
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'September' THEN 9
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'October' THEN 10
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'November' THEN 11
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS 'December' THEN 12
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN TRY_CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
    ELSE TRY_CAST(split_part(split_part(p.birth_date, ',', 1), ' ', 2) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_day
WHERE (p.draft_pick IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <= 62)
   OR p.birth_date = '1997/8/7'
   OR (p.college IS NOT NULL AND p.college <> 'Oregon State University')
   OR (p.nba_championships IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 2)
WITH p, 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN p.draft_pick AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player
